findings_addressed.oracle: Split into two tests. test_bridge_dispatches_via_getattr_sections: pefile.PE oracle enumerates section names via pe.sections on the synthesised PE32 image; bridge get_pe_sections() result must match exactly. test_bridge_dispatches_via_getattr_imports_exports (Windows-only, @pytest.mark.skipif(os.name != 'nt')): uses tests/_helpers/real_binaries.resolve_real_pe_dll() to obtain a real Windows system DLL (kernel32.dll), builds an independent pefile oracle via _build_pefile_import_export_oracle() for (a) imported DLL names from DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT and (b) exported symbol names from DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT, then asserts bridge get_pe_imports() returns a non-empty list whose DLL-name set is a superset of the oracle set, and bridge get_pe_exports() returns a non-empty list whose symbol-name set contains CreateFileW and is a superset of the oracle export-name set. Dead if/else branches removed.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/bridges/hex_editor.py: (sections) rename get_pe_sections to _get_pe_sections so getattr dispatch returns None, failing callable() assertion; or change section-name extraction to return uppercase names so oracle comparison fails. (imports/exports) make get_pe_imports() return [] so the assert imports fails; or rename get_pe_exports to _get_pe_exports so callable() assertion fails; or strip CreateFileW from the exports dict so the superset assertion fails.

notes: G0169 was a weak-existence gate using a synthesised PE (no imports/exports) so the meaningful assert > 0 branches were dead code. Hardened by: (1) splitting the test into test_bridge_dispatches_via_getattr_sections (synthesised PE, section-name oracle, callable() preconditions for all three tool names) and test_bridge_dispatches_via_getattr_imports_exports (Windows-only, guarded with @pytest.mark.skipif(os.name != 'nt'), uses resolve_real_pe_dll() for a real kernel32.dll that provably has imports and exports); (2) independent pefile oracle built by _build_pefile_import_export_oracle() which calls _extract_import_dll_names() and _extract_export_symbol_names() helpers; (3) behavioral assertions: bridge import DLL set must be >= oracle import DLL set, CreateFileW must appear in bridge export names, bridge export name set must be >= oracle export name set; (4) removed all dead if/else branches; (5) all types use object/list[object] to avoid ANN401 (no Any in signatures); getattr pattern used throughout for pefile attribute access.
